Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.runtime.spi

Interface BlobStoreFactory

All Known Implementing Classes:
AzureBlobStoreFactory, GcsBlobStoreFactory, S3BlobStoreFactory, SpringBlobStoreFactory
public interface BlobStoreFactory
Creates the BlobStores of a target. A provider runtime module registers an implementation in META-INF/services/eu.cloudhopper.mc.runtime.spi.BlobStoreFactory; the first one found is used. The deployment passes the bucket's deployed name as the configuration property cloudhopper.bucket.<name>.name (environment variable CLOUDHOPPER_BUCKET_<NAME>_NAME); without it, the name from @Bucket is used.

The stores a factory returns need not check the declared access: BlobStores does that before calling them. They throw BlobAccessDeniedException when the platform refuses an operation, and BlobStoreException for other failures.
